summary: Sunrise Realty Trust filed an 8-K confirming completion on November 5, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of Southern Realty Trust Inc., which merged into Sunrise Merger Sub LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Sunrise, at 1:30 p.m. Eastern. Concurrently, Sunrise entered an amended and restated management agreement with external manager SUNS Manager, cutting the incentive hurdle to 1.75% quarterly/7.0% annual from 2.0%/8.0%, reducing incentive compensation to 17.5% of Core Earnings from 20%, revising the catch-up to 153.85%, removing internalization provisions, and granting a $250,000 per quarter base-fee reduction for four quarters. No financial terms or board recommendation disclosed; watch integration, financing and NASDAQ overhang.
